notes.title: Version 1.3.2
notes.content: [p]We are excited to announce version 1.3.2 of our game![/p][list][*][p]The issue with Steam Link not launching properly has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p]It took a lot of experimentation to identify the cause of the crash when using Steam Link. As it turns out, the splash screen displaying our logo was responsible, so we’ve disabled it in the Steam version of the game.[/p][p]We're particularly flabbergasted by this, as the issue doesn’t occur in the demo version of our other game—which uses the same splash screen. It seems to be one of Game Maker's quirks.[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.3.1 released!
notes.content:
[p]We are excited to announce the release of version 1.3.1 of our game![/p][p]• More tutorials have been added and expanded.
• Tutorial popups now appear during levels.
• An option to turn off tutorial popups has been added.
• Fixed a bug where teleporting between portals in the hub of the first act caused music transitions to not work properly.
• Fixed a bug where leaderboard windows sometimes wouldn’t close automatically.[/p][p]Regarding the issue with Steam Link, we are postponing the fix to the next update, as it is a Steam-only feature.[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 released
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to announce version 1.3.0 of our game, which introduces two new levels![/p][list][*][p]Based on feedback and monitored data, we've decided that the levels [b]COMMUNICATE[/b] and [b]FOR_REAL[/b] require warm-up levels before them.[/p][/*][*][p]The level [b]COMMUNICATE[/b] has been renamed to [b]DISTANT_UNLINK[/b], and a new level named [b]COMMUNICATE[/b] has been added before it.[/p][/*][*][p]A new level, [b]WARMUP[/b], has been added before [b]FOR_REAL[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]If you load a save where a level following a newly added one has already been completed, the new level will be marked as completed but will not count as a true completion.[/p][/*][*][p]Level requirements for all progress locks have been increased by 2.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve also made the following changes and improvements:[/p][list][*][p]You can now press [b]F11[/b] to toggle fullscreen mode.[/p][/*][*][p]A tip for the [b]3_EQUALS_4[/b] level now appears at the start of the level.[/p][/*][/list][p]Lastly, we’re currently working on:[/p][list][*][p]Improved tutorials[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for Steam Link support[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 released!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of BitLiberator version 1.2.0!

This update introduces a major new feature: [b]gamepad support[/b]!

[list]
[*] You can now plug in a gamepad and play the game with it.
[*] New gamepad options have been added, allowing you to configure buttons, dead zones, and cursor speed.
[/list]

We’ve also included various quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes:

[list]
[*] You can now hold the left mouse button to select multiple allies at once.
[*] In hub levels, clicking on a portal to an available level will instantly move you to it. Clicking on an activated portal will teleport you directly to that level.
[*] Added an option to automatically move to a portal when hovering the cursor over it.
[*] Fixed a bug that could crash the game when creating links in the Battleship level.
[*] Fixed a bug where regained energy from removing upgrades wasn’t visible during active pause.
[*] Active pause is now mentioned in tutorials.
[*] Added options to set key bindings for Enter and Shift.
[*] Added an option to customize the colors of background texts.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.0
notes.content: [p]We are excited to announce the release of version 1.1.0 of our demo, which introduces a major new feature to the game.[/p][list][*][p]You can now press the spacebar for an active pause. During active pause, you can see where your allies are heading, issue commands to them, and also direct your main program. If you direct your main program and it reaches its destination without you using the direction keys to alter its movement, the automatic pause will resume.[/p][/*][*][p]We've also added an option to set custom colors for the lines indicating the movement of your allies.[/p][/*][/list][p]Additional improvements include:[/p][list][*][p]An option to change the color of your main program.[/p][/*][*][p]An option to adjust the thickness of the outline around scanned constructions.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved control when using direction keys while the game is paused.[/p][/*][/list][p]We're also excited to announce a feature that will be included in the full version of the game: [b]leaderboards[/b]![/p][list][*][p]Compete with players from around the world to achieve the highest Liberation score or the fastest time for each level.[/p][/*][*][p]Ties in the Liberation score category will be resolved by comparing the fastest time to achieve the given score.[/p][/*][*][p]You can compete globally or among your friends.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
Following the feedback we've received, we're introducing the following bug fixes and improvements:

• In sub-menus, you can now press Escape to return to the previous menu.
• You can use the left mouse button to start the game during the title drop.
• Added an option to change the upgrade colors for Allies and Enemies.
• Fixed a potential bug that prevented the game from starting due to a different language setting on your Windows system.

notes.title: Demo version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Based on the feedback we received, we’ve added the following quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes to the demo:

•	You can now use the mouse to click on options in the menu.
•	Fixed a bug where you would remain in precise mode (Alt key pressed) if you used Alt+Tab to switch out of the game.
•	Added more visible tips to the tutorial and increased their font size.
•	Added an option to always show previous tips.
•	Fixed a bug where the sound and music volumes would not reflect the settings after restarting the game.
•	The game now automatically pauses when it loses focus.
•	Added an option to change the color and transparency of signals.
•	Added an option to change the color of level markers in hub levels.
•	Added an option to change the color of the scanner outline for Allies and Enemies.
•	Added key binding settings.
•	Fullscreen mode is now borderless.
•	The automatic save is no longer overwritten immediately upon starting a new game.
•	Pressing the Space Bar now only pauses the game without showing the menu.
•	Added an option for a seamless moving background text.
•	Increased the font size of the background text.
